newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 26.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Anaconda Nickel NL said on Monday that Glencore Ag would pay US$220 million for a 40 percent stake in the Murrin Murrin nickel-cobalt project in Western Australia. The company also said that Korean interests had bid for 15 percent of the project.

Forrestania Gold NL said on Monday it had received notice from Canadian mining group LionOre Mining International Ltd that it intends to make a cash and scrip takeover bid which valued Forrestania shares at A$3.35 each. Forrestania shareholders will have the chance to receive at least 50 percent cash and the balance in LionOre scrip, based on A$3.35 per Forrestania share or one LionOre share for each Forrestania share. LionOre shares closed up 25 cents at C$3.30 overnight.

Argyle diamond mine partner Ashton Mining Ltd said late on Monday there were "good signs" for worldwide diamond demand during the 1996 Christmas period. "The indications are that the Christmas retail period is, in an international sense..., beginning to show good signs," Ashton chief executive John Robinson told a media briefing.
Harvey Norman holds its annual meeting at 11.00 a.m. (0000 GMT).
Wesfarmers chief executive Mike Chaney addresses Securities Institute in Sydney at ANA Hotel at 12.30 p.m. (0130 GMT).
Newspapers report market speculation that Hudson Conway Ltd sold its 4.47 percent or 7.72 million share stake in PBL on Friday for A$41 million.

McIntosh Securities Ltd said late on Monday it would accept the A$1.40 per share takeover offer from New York brokerage firm Merrill Lynch & Co Inc in the absence of a higher offer. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
